name: wx-vsce-log-viewer
description: Pretty viewer for .log files with ANSI escape sequence rendering

logViewer.renderAnsi.description: Render ANSI terminal escape sequences as colored text. When disabled, raw escape sequences are shown.

logViewer.wordWrap.description: Wrap long lines in the log viewer.

logViewer.lineNumbers.description: Show the original file line number in a left gutter. Can be toggled at runtime from the toolbar.

logViewer.maxFileSizeBytes.description: Maximum log file size to render (default 8 MB). Larger files fall back to raw text.

logViewer.fontSize.description: Font size in px for the log viewer. 0 means use the editor's default font size.

enumDescriptions: Show all lines; matched lines are highlighted with their filter color
Show only lines that match at least one enabled filter (or the search text)
logViewer.filterMode.description: How filter rules and the search box affect which lines are shown.

logViewer.filters.markdownDescription:
**Legacy** flat filter list. Prefer `logViewer.filterSets` instead. When `filterSets` is empty, these rules appear as a synthetic "Default" set. Example:

```json
[
  { "name": "Error", "pattern": "ERROR|FATAL", "regex": true, "color": "#5a1f1f" },
  { "name": "Warn", "pattern": "WARN", "color": "#5a4a1f" }
]
```

name.description: Display name shown on the toolbar chip.

pattern.description: Substring or regular expression to match against each line.

regex.description: Treat 'pattern' as a JavaScript regular expression.

color.description: CSS color used as the line background highlight (e.g. '#5a1f1f' or 'rgba(255,0,0,0.15)').

enabled.description: Whether this rule is enabled by default. Can be toggled at runtime from the toolbar.

name.description: Unique display name for the set.

description.description: Optional notes about when to use this set.

enabled.description: Whether this set is active by default. Can be toggled at runtime from the toolbar.

logViewer.streamingThresholdBytes.description: Files larger than this size (in bytes, default 4 MB) use the streaming pipeline: a background indexer builds a sparse line index, and the viewer renders only the visible window. Smaller files keep the original whole-document path.

logViewer.indexLocation.markdownDescription:
Where to persist the line index for large logs.
- `memory` (default): kept in memory only — never written to disk, discarded when the editor closes, and rebuilt on the next open. The index is tiny (~8 bytes per 1024 lines), so rebuilds are fast even for multi-GB logs.
- `globalStorage`: under the extension's global storage — safe, hidden, never fails on read-only paths, and reused across sessions.
- `adjacent`: writes `<name>.bin` next to the log itself. Falls back to globalStorage if the directory isn't writable.
- `directory`: a user-configured path; see `logViewer.indexDirectory`.

logViewer.indexDirectory.description: Custom directory for index files. Used only when logViewer.indexLocation = 'directory'. Supports a leading '~/' to reference the home directory.

logViewer.indexAnchorStride.description: Anchor every Nth line in the line index. Larger values shrink the in-memory index (~1 KB per 100 MB of log at stride 1024) at the cost of slightly slower goto-line. Power-user setting; the default is appropriate for most workloads.

logViewer.indexCacheBudgetMB.description: Maximum total size (MB) of the persistent index cache. Oldest-`atime` files are evicted past the budget. Applies to globalStorage and directory modes; adjacent files are never auto-evicted.

logViewer.colorPalette.description: Custom CSS colors appended to the built-in palette in the filter editor. Colors added via the editor's color picker are stored here.

scripts.package: pnpm run build:wasm && pnpm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository
